description.value: "Serena was happy at Staverley. She loved to roam the stately gardens of her family manor and dream of her future love. But then cruel fate dealt her a shattering blow. Her father was killed in a duel after losing her hand, her inheritance and her home in a game of cards. All this was now the property of the infamous Marquis of Vulcan -- a man whose reputation made it unwise for any decent woman to be seen in his company. A strange, cold man whose clifftop mansion echoed with terrible secrets." --Back cover.
